name: Etch Express

original_description: Etch Express helps trophy, award, and engraving shops prepare production designs. Create and edit engraving jobs, recipient tables, plate layouts, and bed layouts; reuse saved templates; upload artwork and source documents; validate saved geometry; and export PDF or SVG ZIP files. Manage store inventory, view analytics, and update store and organization settings according to your account permissions.
